originalTitle: Amazon’s new Kindles appear to have a light leak problem

content: Some users are reporting that the new Kindles have a light leak issue that is especially apparent when using dark mode. The latest base-model Kindles have a flush bezel that gives them a sleek appearance and looks great… as long as you keep the lights on. But things can change once you turn down the lights and turn up the brightness on the e-reader. In some cases, users see shadows around the edges of the screen, or even visible LED strips. The issue appears to affect both the plastic and aluminum models in all colors. Some minor glowing around the edges might be a byproduct of the combination of front lighting and a flush screen. But Reddit users say images shared there show something more dramatic that appears to be a defect. [Media: https://www.reddit.com/r/kindle/comments/1x0opj1/light_bleeding_in_new_basic_2026/] Good e-Reader says that Amazon is aware of the issue and has confirmed that a manufacturing issue may have led to defects in the current batch of Kindles. When contacted by The Verge, Amazon spokesperson Katie Condon said, “In certain, highly specific conditions, such as using dark mode at a higher brightness settings in a dark environment, customers may see a subtle glow on the edge of the display on devices with colored bezels. This can be mitigated by adjusting the front light to a lower level.” Update October 9th, 2026: Added statement from Amazon.
chineseTitle: 亚马逊新款 Kindle 似乎存在漏光问题
chineseSummary: 一些用户报告称，新款 Kindle 存在漏光问题，在使用深色模式时尤其明显。最新的基础型号 Kindle 具有齐平边框，外观时尚，看起来很棒……只要您保持灯亮着。但一旦你拒绝[…]，事情就会改变。
chineseContent: 一些用户报告称，新款 Kindle 存在漏光问题，在使用深色模式时尤其明显。最新的基础型号 Kindle 具有齐平边框，外观时尚，看起来很棒……只要您保持灯亮着。但一旦你关掉灯并调高电子阅读器的亮度，情况就会发生变化。在某些情况下，用户会看到屏幕边缘周围有阴影，甚至可见 LED 灯条。该问题似乎影响所有颜色的塑料和铝制型号。边缘周围的一些轻微发光可能是前照明和齐平屏幕组合的副产品。但 Reddit 用户表示，那里分享的图像显示出一些更引人注目的东西，这似乎是一个缺陷。 【媒体：https://www.reddit.com/r/kindle/comments/1x0opj1/light_bleeding_in_new_basic_2026/】Good e-Reader表示，亚马逊已意识到这一问题，并已确认制造问题可能导致当前批次的Kindle存在缺陷。在接受 The Verge 采访时，亚马逊发言人凯蒂·康登 (Katie Condon) 表示：“在某些高度特定的条件下，例如在黑暗环境中以较高亮度设置使用黑暗模式，客户可能会在带有彩色边框的设备上看到显示屏边缘发出微妙的光芒。可以通过将前灯调整到较低水平来缓解这种情况。” 2026 年 10 月 9 日更新：添加了亚马逊的声明。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于 AI 与科技趋势信号，适合用于观察工具选型、产品机会、开发者关注点和技术路线变化。
